Subset DP chooses original elements in their final order. Moving the chosen element to the next output position crosses exactly the still-unselected earlier elements, giving the minimum adjacent-swap cost; independently pay the exact value adjustment cost.

Extend a suffix automaton for each integer symbol. Each extension introduces length(current)-length(suffix_link(current)) new substrings; cloning only redistributes existing classes. Report the cumulative count after every append, not only at the end.
Build an inverted word-to-article index, deduplicating each article before appending its index. Sequential article processing keeps postings sorted. Missing query words produce an actual empty line.

For destinations beyond direct reacha[i], jumping first to the reachable station with furthest reach is optimal. Its total-distance sum can be reused, replacing distances to stations at mosta[i] with one; the resulting recurrence is dp[i]=dp[j]+n-i-1-(a[i]-j). A range-maximum tree choosesj.

Represent skipped task income, per-task rental fees, and shared machine purchase costs as a minimum cut: source-to-task income, task-to-machine rent, machine-to-sink purchase. Total income minus mincut is maximum profit, with duplicate machine steps contributing their separate rents.

The pairwise concatenation comparator fixes an optimal order for every selected subset. Process that order backward with a choose-K DP, prepending the same string to comparable suffixes; this avoids invalid lexicographic prefix-DP pruning when lengths differ.

A substring can be permuted into a palindrome iff at most one letter has odd count. Prefix parity masks reduce this to equal masks or masks differing by one bit; retain earliest positions to maximize substring length.

Subset DP handles the lowest remaining stick by either leaving it unused or pairing it with every valid remaining pair. Every partition is covered once this way; compute valid triangle areas via Heron factors and maximize their sum.

Maintain suffix sums and minima while scanning possible eaten-prefix lengths backward. Compare reduced grading averages by integer cross products, retaining every tied optimum and reversing indices for ascending output.

Simulate the single permitted LIFO siding, pushing incoming cars until the next desired output is available. If it is buried after all cars arrive, the order is impossible. Keep the two distinct zero terminators and blank lines between datasets.

Sort by one rating. Higher entries always reach lower entries; an inversion of the other rating links its entire interval into one strongly connected component. A boundary exists exactly when the prefix maximum of the other rating is below the suffix minimum. Each component reaches itself and all earlier components.
